description:
Shape of Dreams is a roguelite action game where Travelers journey through dreams,
collecting Memories and Essences to build their power.

v0.2.0.description:
**Early development build.** The solo/host basics work in-game; winning runs, higher difficulties, offline play and co-op are still untested (see [TESTING.md](https://github.com/FruityShuffles/SoDArchipelago/blob/main/TESTING.md)).

### Download
- `shape_of_dreams.apworld`: the Archipelago world, for generating seeds. Install it by double-clicking it, or copy it into Archipelago's `custom_worlds` folder. Needs Archipelago 0.6.4 or newer.

- The client mod: subscribe to [Archipelago Randomizer](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3809735647) on the Steam Workshop.

### What's randomized
- **Locations (228):** 93 achievements, plus 135 world clears (worlds 1–5 × Deep Sleep / Ominous Dream / Nightmare × 9 Travelers).
- **Items (228):** progressive Traveler unlocks (Traveler, then 3 alternate memories), General Memory, Essence and Lucid Dream unlocks, Mastery packs and Stardust.
- **Goal:** win at the chosen difficulty or harder with a chosen number of different Travelers.
- DeathLink supported (not on a joining co-op client).

See the [design doc](https://github.com/FruityShuffles/SoDArchipelago/blob/main/DESIGN.md) and the [setup guide](https://github.com/FruityShuffles/SoDArchipelago/blob/main/apworld/shape_of_dreams/docs/setup_en.md).

### Compatibility
The mod refuses seeds whose data doesn't match its own (`data_hash` `8b011d44…`). Use the apworld and the mod from the same release.

v0.3.0.description:
**Early development build.** The solo/host basics work in-game; winning runs, higher difficulties, offline play and co-op are still untested, and so are the two new options below (see [TESTING.md](https://github.com/FruityShuffles/SoDArchipelago/blob/main/TESTING.md)).

### New in 0.3.0
- **Forced Lucid Dreams** (`forced_evil_lucid_dreams`, `forced_chaotic_lucid_dreams`, off by default): the listed Evil/Chaotic Lucid Dreams stay on in every run until you receive their item. Those items become progression, and a run only counts for world clears and the goal with every still-forced dream on.
- **Shuffled star requirements** (`shuffle_star_requirements`, **on by default**): constellation stars trade their mastery requirements with stars of the same Traveler (or the common stars) and category.
- The example YAML is attached: the default settings, with every option explained.

### Download
- `shape_of_dreams.apworld`: the Archipelago world, for generating seeds. Install it by double-clicking it, or copy it into Archipelago's `custom_worlds` folder. Needs Archipelago 0.6.4 or newer.
- `Shape.of.Dreams.yaml`: the example player YAML. Change `name`, then put it in Archipelago's `Players` folder.
- The client mod: subscribe to [Archipelago Randomizer](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3809735647) on the Steam Workshop (version 0.3.0).

### What's randomized
- **Locations (228):** 93 achievements, plus 135 world clears (worlds 1–5 × Deep Sleep / Ominous Dream / Nightmare × 9 Travelers).
- **Items (228):** progressive Traveler unlocks (Traveler, then 3 alternate memories), General Memory, Essence and Lucid Dream unlocks, Mastery packs and Stardust.
- **Goal:** win at the chosen difficulty or harder with a chosen number of different Travelers.
- DeathLink supported (not on a joining co-op client).

See the [design doc](https://github.com/FruityShuffles/SoDArchipelago/blob/main/DESIGN.md) and the [setup guide](https://github.com/FruityShuffles/SoDArchipelago/blob/main/apworld/shape_of_dreams/docs/setup_en.md).

### Compatibility
The mod refuses seeds whose data doesn't match its own (`data_hash` `8b011d44…`, unchanged from 0.2.0). Use the apworld and the mod from the same release.

v0.4.0.description:
### New in 0.4.0
- **Random starting Travelers:** each seed starts you with 2 random Travelers instead of Lacerta and Mist. Their first `Progressive <Traveler>` copy is a starting item (shown as `(starting item)` in the message feed), and Lacerta and Mist are now items like every other Traveler. The logic is the same for all 9 Travelers.
- If the lobby would open on a Traveler you don't have, it opens on your first unlocked Traveler instead.

### Compatibility
**Seeds generated before 0.4.0 don't work with this mod** (data format 4, `data_hash` `cd25df83…`). The Workshop updates the mod automatically, so generate a new seed with this apworld. Profiles bound to older seeds can still be played offline and keep Lacerta and Mist, but can't connect. Use the apworld and the mod from the same release.

### Download
- `shape_of_dreams.apworld`: the Archipelago world, for generating seeds. Install it by double-clicking it, or copy it into Archipelago's `custom_worlds` folder. Needs Archipelago 0.6.4 or newer.
- `Shape.of.Dreams.yaml`: the example player YAML. Change `name`, then put it in Archipelago's `Players` folder.
- The client mod: subscribe to [Archipelago Randomizer](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3809735647) on the Steam Workshop (version 0.4.0).

See the [game info page](https://github.com/FruityShuffles/SoDArchipelago/blob/main/apworld/shape_of_dreams/docs/en_Shape%20of%20Dreams.md) and the [setup guide](https://github.com/FruityShuffles/SoDArchipelago/blob/main/apworld/shape_of_dreams/docs/setup_en.md).

v0.5.0.description:
### New in 0.5.0
- **Lizard shop souvenirs are checks** (17 new locations, 245 in total): owning each souvenir the lizard shop sells sends its check, and you keep the souvenir. They're always excluded, so they only hold filler.
- **Passive mastery** (`passive_mastery`, on by default): turn it off and runs earn no mastery, so mastery only comes from Mastery items. "The Road Not Taken" is then excluded.
- **New filler defaults:** 8 Mastery items per Traveler (mastery 40, the level of each Traveler's last story episode) and 675 Stardust per Stardust item (54,000 in total: every star, star slot and souvenir). `mastery_pack_value` now goes up to 40.
- **Fill:** only Deep Sleep world clears are priority locations, so Shape of Dreams no longer pulls in about half of a multiworld's progression. "Vivid Dream" now needs a Traveler ready for Nightmare and "The Road Not Taken" needs every Traveler copy, so neither can hold an early item. "Who's the Prey Now" is always excluded because the game doesn't count Hunter kills ([#6](https://github.com/FruityShuffles/SoDArchipelago/issues/6)).

### Compatibility
**Seeds generated before 0.5.0 don't work with this mod** (data format 4, `data_hash` `8d43e08a…`). The Workshop updates the mod automatically, so generate a new seed with this apworld. Profiles bound to older seeds can still be played offline, but can't connect. Use the apworld and the mod from the same release.

### Download
- `shape_of_dreams.apworld`: the Archipelago world, for generating seeds. Install it by double-clicking it, or copy it into Archipelago's `custom_worlds` folder. Needs Archipelago 0.6.4 or newer.
- `Shape.of.Dreams.yaml`: the example player YAML. Change `name`, then put it in Archipelago's `Players` folder.
- The client mod: subscribe to [Archipelago Randomizer](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3809735647) on the Steam Workshop (version 0.5.0).

See the [game info page](https://github.com/FruityShuffles/SoDArchipelago/blob/main/apworld/shape_of_dreams/docs/en_Shape%20of%20Dreams.md) and the [setup guide](https://github.com/FruityShuffles/SoDArchipelago/blob/main/apworld/shape_of_dreams/docs/setup_en.md).

v0.5.1.description:
### New in 0.5.1
- **Universal Tracker support:** [Universal Tracker](https://github.com/FarisTheAncient/Archipelago/releases) lists which checks are in logic with what you've received. Install `tracker.apworld` like this apworld, open **Universal Tracker** from the Archipelago Launcher and connect with your slot name. It doesn't need your YAML.
- Achievements show their in-game description next to their name in the tracker.

### Compatibility
An apworld-only release: the mod stays at **0.5.0** and needs no update (same data format and `data_hash`). Seeds generated with 0.5.0 keep working, and tracking them works too.

v0.6.0.description:
### New in 0.6.0
- **Jonas's Wares** (`jonas_wares`, 30 by default): Jonas sells Archipelago items for gold, one per shop. Solo or hosted games only.
- **Shrine, quest and artifact checks** (27 new locations, 302 by default): your first use of each shrine, your first completion of each quest, and handing artifacts in to the Dream Teller. Artifacts are always excluded.
- **In-run items** (`in_run_items`, off by default): Map Blessings add a destination to your map (room bonuses, shrines, a lizard shop or an artifact), and Treasures give Jonas's Treasure effects for free. They apply during a run and wait until they can be used.
- **Curse traps** (`traps`, off by default): about 20% of the new item slots give your Traveler a curse from the Hatred shrine pool.
- **Automatic reconnect:** if the connection to the server drops, the mod keeps retrying on its own, and the OFFLINE notice counts down to the next try. If your room moved to a new port, set the new server and type `ap_connect`.

### Compatibility
**Seeds generated before 0.6.0 don't work with this mod** (data format 5, `data_hash` `fbb7bcce…`). The Workshop updates the mod automatically, so generate a new seed with this apworld. Profiles bound to older seeds can still be played offline, but can't connect. Use the apworld and the mod from the same release.

v0.6.1.description:
### New in 0.6.1
- **Works with Shape of Dreams 1.4.1.** The 0.6.0 mod failed to start properly on a bound profile after the game update.
- **Co-op:** you no longer need to turn off Cross-Play. While the mod is on, only PC players can join your lobby.
- **Cross-Save:** don't turn on Cross-Save sync for a bound profile. Syncing can apply Mastery and Stardust items a second time.
- The game no longer restores mastery levels when it recovers lost progress, so Mastery items can't be applied twice that way. The warning about it is gone.

### Compatibility
Seeds generated with 0.6.0 work with this mod (same `data_hash` `fbb7bcce…`). Use the apworld and the mod from the same release for new seeds.

### Download
- `shape_of_dreams.apworld`: the Archipelago world, for generating seeds. Install it by double-clicking it, or copy it into Archipelago's `custom_worlds` folder. Needs Archipelago 0.6.4 or newer.
- `Shape.of.Dreams.yaml`: the example player YAML. Change `name`, then put it in Archipelago's `Players` folder.
- The client mod: subscribe to [Archipelago Randomizer](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3809735647) on the Steam Workshop (version 0.6.1).

See the [game info page](https://github.com/FruityShuffles/SoDArchipelago/blob/main/apworld/shape_of_dreams/docs/en_Shape%20of%20Dreams.md) and the [setup guide](https://github.com/FruityShuffles/SoDArchipelago/blob/main/apworld/shape_of_dreams/docs/setup_en.md).
